newsitem.title: INDIA: No decision on revised India carry forward - SEBI.
newsitem.headline: No decision on revised India carry forward - SEBI.

text.p: Market regulator the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) did not consider a proposal to revive carry-forward trade in its original form at its board meeting on Thursday, its chairman said.

SEBI banned "badla" or carry forward trade in March 1994 on the ground it was leading to excess speculation. It introduced a modified system of carry forward trade last year with several checks and balances but many brokers are keen to revive "badla" in its original form.
"The BSE (Bombay Stock Exchange) president wants to bring back badla in its original form with a few revisions," SEBI chairman D.R. Mehta told a news conference after the board meeting.
"This is a controversial issue that has to be considered."
